description: Codemod / API-migration style: replace the deprecated textkit.legacy.fmt_cell(value, width, fill=' ') with textkit.render.render_cell(width, fill, value) across thirty report modules. The argument order changed, the new function has no default for fill, and the call sites mix positional, keyword, mixed and multi-line calls with three import styles (from-import, aliased from-import, module alias). A protected checks script compares every module's rendered output with a recorded baseline, rejects any remaining reference to the old name through an AST scan, and turns DeprecationWarning into an error. Thirty files make hand-editing slow, so the iteration budget is generous and the score is behaviour, not tool-call economy.
